cold-scan-index.description: Full walk with metadata into a complete index. No snapshot.

cold-scan-producer.description: Walk and metadata only, no index build. Isolates the syscall layer. Wall time includes an untimed exact validation scan; read component_ns.

warm-revalidate.description: Load a compatible snapshot and reconcile it against the tree. component_ns is reconciliation; wall_ns is the whole warm start.

note: Experiments 010 (H17) and 011 (H13), stacked with successive pairs. cold-scan-producer is the placebo: neither change touches the walk.
